note: Qualified fielders by season. DEM+: sample-shrunk fielding rate, 100 + 10z against that season's pool. Fielding, framing and pos_runs_fg are FanGraphs' published values as fetched; FanGraphs can revise them. pos_runs (in Def) is our ladder as it stands today, applied to every season.

positional.units: runs per 650 PA, pro-rated by innings at each fielding position
positional.note: pos_runs = sum over C to RF of ladder rung x innings at the position / inn_per_650pa. The ladder is inverted from Baseball-Reference's positional runs, so Def is FanGraphs fielding and framing plus a Baseball-Reference-scale positional term, not FanGraphs Def. pos_runs_fg is FanGraphs' own positional, for comparison; it is in no sum.

team_basis.note: CLOSED seasons shown under the club MLB's transaction feed lists today, not the club he played for: a past season can show under a club he joined later. Charts and team totals both follow it, so filtering a club shows the players it holds now. Rows with no club (0) are left out of team totals.
